exposure: Inpatient cervical ripening/induction of labor with misoprostol
inpatient cervical ripening/induction of labor with misoprostol
outpatient cervical ripening with daily misoprostol
Outpatient cervical ripening with daily misoprostol
cohort: 56 low-risk pregnant women who underwent outpatient cervical ripening with daily dosing of misoprostol and 56 matched controls who underwent inpatient cervical ripening/induction of labor with misoprostol
finding: Outpatient cervical ripening with misoprostol was associated with a significantly shorter time from admission to delivery compared to inpatient cervical ripening in low-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: There were no differences in the frequency of cesarean delivery between the outpatient and inpatient groups.
